## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] I tested the affected workflow in Raycast when applicable.

## Privacy and licensing

- [ ] I did not include Codex databases, JSONL files, conversation content, private repository names, private paths, or credentials.
- [ ] New handwritten source files include the appropriate SPDX headers.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when appropriate.
